# nanoflags_project (Data Source)

Reads a project. Projects are created in the dashboard; the Management API reads them. Any valid token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nanoflags_project" "web" {
  key = "web"
}

output "default_environment" {
  value = data.nanoflags_project.web.default_environment
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Project key or id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `default_environment` (String) Key of the default environment.
- `id` (String) Project id (UUID).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `timezone` (String) Project time zone (IANA).
